text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Digital!! I heard today's your 
birthday!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If it's your birthday, that means there's 
cake! Hand over some cake to Windy-chan 
too, right now!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, what, eeeeek! What is this 
10-billion-point cute creature doing 
here!?)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Cake on your birthday!! Such an innocent, 
completely trusting mind!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Too cuuute, I'm gonna swooon~~~!\nThis 
Digi-tan will prepare as much cake as you 
want,\nwhenever you want, though!?!?)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, why are you keeping quiet? Listen 
to Windy-chan properly!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Windy-chan wants cake! Take me to the cake 
right now, nah-ha~~!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
U-U-Um, but are you sure it's alright?! 
Someone like me sitting at the same table 
with Lady Windy! It's far too gracious!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Shut up, shut up, shut uuup! Whatever 
Windy-chan says is the absolute law!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If you don't hurry up, Windy-chan's gonna 
eat all of Digital's share, too!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Eeehhn, you can have it all~~!! Getting to 
spend time with my fave... is priceless!
